items.text_vn: Cho 5 sao không trừ. Mình chơi game này từ hồi lớp 1, giờ quay lại chơi vẫn thấy vui như xưa. Minigame thì cực kỳ vui, ký ức cứ ùa về trong đầu luôn 🫶🏻🫶🏻

items.text_en: Full 5 stars. I've played this since 1st grade, and coming back now it's still as fun as before. The minigames are super fun, all the memories came flooding back 🫶🏻🫶🏻

items.summary_vn: Trang phục ít, chưa hợp gu; NPC vẫn nói tiếng Anh dù chọn tiếng Thái.
items.text_en: Good game, but taking off a star because there still aren't many outfits and they don't suit many people's taste. Also, the NPCs speak English even though I set it to Thai.
items.summary_en: Few outfits that don't suit tastes; NPCs speak English despite Thai setting.
